# Coco 2.0.0

## What changes in 2.0

- Play standard chess and Chess960.
- Every executable includes the Ravager v3 network.
- Improved search and a more conservative low-clock cutoff.

Thanks to **erensh27** for the Ravager v3 network and evaluator.
[Third-party notices](../third_party/NOTICES.md) are included in the matching release source.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/NotKaede-11/Coco-Engine/blob/v2.0.0/CHANGELOG.md#200)
for the full changes and local match results.
